title: Vivo, the musical little animal.
lines: In Havana, a warm city on the island of Cuba, lives a little animal.
That's a small brown animal with big eyes and a long tail, a bit like a monkey.
Vivo lives with an old musician.
Every day Vivo and Andrés go to the square.
Andrés and Vivo are best friends.
They have been making music together for years.
One day Andrés gets a letter.
A letter from a woman called Marta.
She lives in Miami, in America.
Long ago Andrés and Marta were musicians together.
He wrote a song for her.
But he never gave it to her.
And then Marta went away to become famous.
Now Marta is giving her last concert.
And she asks if Andrés will come.
He takes the song with him, in an old envelope.
But that night Andrés gets ill.
He sits alone in the square.
He doesn't feel like making music anymore.
But then he thinks about the song.
Andrés wanted so much to give it to Marta.
Vivo decides: I'll take the song to Marta!
But Miami is very far away.
How can a little animal get there?
A girl from Miami comes to Andrés's funeral.
She has purple hair and she wears boots in every colour.
She always does things her own way.
Vivo secretly crawls into Gabi's suitcase.
That way he flies with her on the plane to America.
In Miami Gabi finds the little animal in her suitcase.
But Gabi can understand Vivo when he sings.
She hears the story of the song.
And Gabi says: I'll help you!
But Marta is giving her concert in another city.
Gabi and Vivo have to go through the swamps.
Those are big stretches of water with tall grass and trees.
He sings a song and Gabi drums.
In the swamp they also fall into the water.
The envelope with the song gets wet.
But then Gabi says: You know the song, don't you?
You've heard it so often, when Andrés played it.
By bus, by boat, on foot.
And at last they reach the big concert hall where Marta is singing.
Marta has grown old, with silvery grey hair.
She's sad that Andrés isn't there.
Marta sings the song at her concert that night.
It's the most beautiful song she has ever sung.
Vivo goes to live with Gabi in Miami.
